texts.zh: 我们在对[Root.GetName]的深度空间跟踪矩阵有了重要的发现——目前正有一颗巨大的小行星正在向[Root.GetPlanetMoon]飞来！如果任由它撞击表面的话，将会造成灾难性的后果。必须尽早消灭这颗小行星！
texts.en:
Our deep space tracking arrays on [Root.GetName] have made an alarming discovery - a large asteroid is heading towards the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] on a direct collision course! Should it impact the surface, the consequences would be disastrous.

The asteroid must be destroyed before it is too late!

label.zh: 若玩家在其撞击前击毁该小行星舰队
label.en: If the player destroys the asteroid fleet before impact

texts.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的碰撞轨道上探测到了一颗体积巨大的小行星。必须在它撞击地面之前将它摧毁！
texts.en: A large asteroid has been detected on a collision course with [Root.GetName]. It must be destroyed before it impacts the surface!

texts.zh: 我们没能及时制止往[Root.GetName]方向的小行星撞击，它径直撞上了[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面，造成了大范围的破坏，有数百万人失去了生命。
texts.en: We failed to stop the asteroid that was heading for [Root.GetName] in time. It has collided with the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, causing widespread devastation and untold suffering. Millions are dead.

texts.zh: 我们没能及时阻止飞往[Root.GetName]的小行星。它撞击到[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的表面，造成了大面积的破坏。数千的机器单位永远无法再运作。
texts.en: We failed to stop the asteroid that was heading for [Root.GetName] in time. It has collided with the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, causing widespread devastation and destruction. Millions of machine units have been rendered terminally inoperable.

label.zh: 今天是一个黑暗的日子。

texts.zh: 向[Root.GetName]飞来的小行星已经被摧毁了！[Root.GetPlanetMoon]九死一生的平民们都在街上庆祝。扫描后发现小行星的残骸中蕴含着许多有价值的矿产，我们已经尽我们所能回收了许多矿产。
texts.en:
The asteroid that was approaching [Root.GetName] on a collision course has been destroyed! With their doom averted, our jubilant citizens on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have taken to the streets in celebration.

A scan of the remaining fragments has also revealed that the asteroid consisted largely of valuable minerals. We have collected what we could.

texts.zh:
向[Root.GetName]飞来的小行星已经被摧毁了！星球上没有单位或建筑受损，因为任何残余的碎片都小到在进入大气层时被分解了。

对残余碎片的扫描发现小行星主要由有价值的矿物构成。我们已尽量进行回收。
texts.en:
The asteroid that was approaching [Root.GetName] on a collision course has been destroyed! No planetside units or structures have been affected by the event, as any inbound debris was small enough to disintegrate on atmospheric entry.

A scan of the remaining fragments has also revealed that the asteroid consisted largely of valuable minerals. We have collected what we could.

summary.text:
# 小行星来袭 / Asteroid Sighted

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/colony_events_1.txt:4231-4520`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1619,3759,3811`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 殖民地2岁（6/958）或3岁（6/739）时的随机事件；全局一次（asteroid_sighted_global），每个帝国一次；非AI、非首都，排除栖息地、环世界、方舟；非荒野帝国。
  Random colony event at age 2 (6/958) or 3 (6/739); once per game and per empire; non-AI, non-capital; excludes habitats, rings, arks and wilderness empires.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 180「小行星来袭」：创建一支“小行星”舰队，在殖民地75单位外出现并驶向殖民地；开启事件链（机械帝国有另一版本选项）。
  180 "Asteroid Sighted": spawns an asteroid fleet 75 units away that moves to the colony, and starts the event chain (machine empires have a variant option).
- 玩家若在其到达前击毁舰队 → 182「小行星已被摧毁」（链结束）。
  If the player destroys the fleet before arrival -> 182 "Asteroid Destroyed" (chain ends).
- 舰队到达 → 183「小行星撞击」：形成陨石坑，按人口规模（≤200 / ≤600 / >600）杀死1/2/4个人口群，随后隐藏事件184清理舰队。
  Fleet arrives -> 183 "Asteroid Impacts": a crater is left and 1/2/4 pop groups are killed by population (<=200 / <=600 / >600); hidden event 184 then cleans up.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 182 与 183 互斥。
  182 and 183 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 机械帝国看到不同措辞。
  Machine empires see different wording.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发、舰队创建与到达效果、on_action 对 181 的调用、182/183 的结果。
  Checked: trigger, fleet creation and arrival effect, the on_action call to 181, results of 182/183.
- 更正：181（隐藏）并入，182 作为击毁结局接在180之后。
  Correction: 181 (hidden) merged; 182 now follows 180 as the destroyed ending.
